Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
import pyaudio
import websockets
import asyncio
import json
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

# Deepgram streaming speech-to-text
DEEPGRAM_API_KEY = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
DEEPGRAM_URL = "wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen?encoding=linear16&sample_rate=16000&channels=1&interim_results=true"

CHUNK = 1024
FORMAT = pyaudio.paInt16
CHANNELS = 1
RATE = 16000

async def stream_microphone():
    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    stream = p.open(format=FORMAT,
                    channels=CHANNELS,
                    rate=RATE,
                    input=True,
                    frames_per_buffer=CHUNK)

    async with websockets.connect(DEEPGRAM_URL,
                                 extra_headers={"Authorization": f"Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}"}) as ws:
        async def sender():
            try:
                while True:
                    data = stream.read(CHUNK, exception_on_overflow=False)
                    await ws.send(data)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Sender error: {e}")
            finally:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({"type": "CloseStream"}))

        async def receiver():
            async for msg in ws:
                response = json.loads(msg)
                if response.get("is_final"):
                    transcript = response["channel"]["alternatives"][0]["transcript"]
                    if transcript:
                        yield transcript

        await asyncio.gather(sender(), receiver().__aiter__())

    stream.stop_stream()
    stream.close()
    p.terminate()

def speech_to_text():
    return stream_microphone()
```
